[[Cleansing Morostav Trail (Hard mode)]]
[[Memories of Purity]] | map = [[File:Cleansing Morostav Trail.jpg|250px]] | map1text = From [[Durheim Archives]] }} Go with the [[Ministry of Purity]] to [[Morostav Trail]] to destroy the last remnants of the [[Afflicted]] in [[Cantha]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat the Afflicted in Morostav Trail. * See [[Initiate Zei Ri]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *5,000 [[Experience]] *2,500 [[Gold]] *[[Ministerial Commendation]] ===Environmental changes=== * Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in [[Morostav Trail (Winds of Change)|Morostav Trail]], specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn. The [[Ritualist's Construct]] also disappears after completion of this quest, which makes [[Soul Twisting]] much more time-consuming to capture without [[Memories of Purity]] active. ==Walkthrough== Leave from [[Durheim Archives]] and head west-north-west. You will fight through a few groups before arriving at a circular clearing filled with afflicted. There are 8 groups, each with its own boss representing one of the factions professions. Work your way around the circle, either clockwise or counter clockwise. backed the Afflicted into a corner. This is it. The other members of the Ministry who were engaged in [[Drazach Thicket]] have joined us, and we're going to need their support. Do you remember that abomination we fought at [[Pongmei Valley]]? It's just like that...only this time it isn't alone. There's several of them. Well, that's the way of the world, isn't it? Nothing is ever easy; nothing worth fighting for, anyway. But think of it: the land is finally purged, and [[Reiko]]'s vision has been brought to fruition. The fighting can end, and the reconstruction can begin.'' :''"The ancestors have looked upon us favorably thus far.
